company.name: TILT
company.shortDescription: TILT app is an online shopping platform that allows users to buy through videos, live streams, and earn rewards.
company.description:
TILT app allow users to discover small brands, buy through videos, live streams, and earn rewards. It allows emerging Gen Z fashion brands to add a new dimension to their brand by building and connecting with communities of like-minded shoppers who can purchase products directly from the app. In seconds, brands can connect their stores to Tilt and begin creating shoppable videos and live streams. They have easily been discovered thanks to social mechanics and curated feeds, which give the impression of shopping with friends.

Users can view products in action and purchase them directly from the app, without having to navigate to another website or create separate accounts for each store. Tilt aims to eliminate boredom inherent in online shopping and reignite the joy of connecting with like-minded shoppers.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $26,000,000, or 55.2% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $14,330,532 to $171,024,279, a 11.93x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
